fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Jinja text for the og:site_name tag, for example {{ site.brand }}. Empty: no change

fields.label: Title Template
fields.description: Jinja text for pages that no SEO Rule gives a title. Empty: no change

fields.label: Description Template
fields.description: Jinja text for pages that no SEO Rule gives a description. Empty: no change

fields.label: Title Limit
fields.description: The save of a rule warns above this length. Empty: 60

fields.label: Description Limit
fields.description: A longer description is cut. Empty: 160

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The source of site.organization. Empty: the default company

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Empty: the primary company address of the Company

fields.label: Social Footer Group
fields.description: The Website Settings footer links under this label are the social profiles. Empty: Social

fields.label: Variant Limit
fields.description: Above this number of variants, a variant has only its address and code. Empty: 200

fields.label: Specifications Heading
fields.description: The H2 above the common specifications of a template page. Empty: no heading

fields.label: Variants Heading
fields.description: The H2 above the variant table. Empty: no heading

fields.label: Price Valid Days
fields.description: priceValidUntil is today plus these days, for an Item Price with no Valid Upto. Empty: not output

fields.label: Handling Days (Max)
fields.description: Empty: no handling time in the markup

fields.label: Transit Days (Max)
fields.description: Empty: no transit time in the markup. The destinations and charges come from the enabled Selling Shipping Rules that have countries

fields.label: Return Policy
fields.description: Empty: no return policy in the markup

fields.label: Return Days
fields.description: Necessary for a finite return window
